meta.title: Speculative test for lockfile install hang
meta.body_summary: Add a regression test and scheduling fix for a lockfile install hang issue; CI shows unrelated test timeouts.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added lockfile install scheduling fix and regression test; author closed PR after CI showed unrelated test timeouts and no review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 34 changed lines across 2 files, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a small experimental fix and regression test for a lockfile hang, but it was closed without merging, likely because it wasn't verified or CI failures discouraged merging.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal human review conducted; only automated CI comment from robobun reporting unrelated test timeouts.
review_details.performance_claim: Fix lockfile install hang by scheduling dependency downloads asynchronously.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author closed PR after CI showed unrelated test failures; no review engagement.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The PR lacked evidence that the scheduling fix resolves the hang; CI reported timeouts in unrelated tests, undermining confidence.

detection_detail.ci_auto: robobun reported CI failures on unrelated tests, but no direct feedback on the lockfile fix.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body states test commands failed due to build dependencies, so the regression test could not be run; no reproduction steps for the actual hang.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no follow-up fix.

core_change_summary.description: In src/install/PackageManager/install_with_manager.zig, added 4 lines to schedule dependency downloads when creating a new lockfile; added test/regression/issue/020850.test.ts to verify the fix.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added scheduling fix and new regression test.

review_signals.summary: CI reported timeouts in test/v8/v8.test.ts and failure in test/js/bun/net/tcp.test.ts, unrelated to the lockfile fix.

collaboration_trajectory: OpenAI_Codex (via Jarred-Sumner) opened PR with scheduling fix and test.
robobun bot reported CI failures immediately.
No human review activity; author closed PR after 2 days.
